CALENDAR_INVITATION.TITLE: Invitation text
CALENDAR_INVITATION.DESCRIPTION: This is what the customer reads in the invitation to their appointment. It is used in every appointment, the agents' and Captain's; each appointment can change it when it is created.
CALENDAR_INVITATION.LOCATION_PLACEHOLDER: 123 Main St, floor 2. Ask for reception.
CALENDAR_INVITATION.LOCATION_HELP: Used where you put the address variable. If you leave it empty, that line is left out.
CALENDAR_INVITATION.PREVIEW: How the customer will see it
CALENDAR_INVITATION.PREVIEW_NOTE: With sample data. Lines whose variables are empty are left out.
CALENDAR_INVITATION.SAVE_ERROR: The invitation text could not be saved.
CALENDAR_INVITATION.LOAD_ERROR: The invitation text could not be loaded.
CALENDAR_INVITATION.USING_DEFAULT: The default text is in use.

MODAL.LABEL: Invitation text
MODAL.HELP: If you do not change it, the account's text is used. The variables are filled in with this appointment's data.
MODAL.PREVIEW: How the customer will see it
MODAL.MEET_NOTE: The Meet link is added when the appointment is created.
